source.historical_negative: FORGE NR-M1P PR #1252; original MG56 artifact #12945140842; 3405 authentic MG19 selected steps; 0/1817 hypothetical MG28 alternatives with prior same-context strict task effects
source.source_eligible_scope: source-free native engineering only, original MiniGrid DEV/CHECK/SEALED and new episode stepping NOT authorized

hypothesis: An opt-in original-public selected consequence memory can store verified original-public door opening and literal-mission exact-target pickup separately from changes caused solely by turning, before the first terminal goal reward; source-ledger only.

native_mechanism.public_inputs: original 7x7x3 image, direction 0..3, literal public mission, selected action 0..6, returned source-public after, original reward, terminal; never privileged map/goal/pose/inventory
native_mechanism.context: own mission + before public direction + front cell triple; prior action evidence only
native_mechanism.effects: door opening only if selected toggle=5, before front is door(type4) state 1/2 and after front door type4 same color state0 and heading unchanged; exact public pickup only if selected pickup=3 and before front object/type/color exactly matches literal pickup mission and after front cell becomes floor type1, heading unchanged
native_mechanism.controls: ignore sighting, turns, camera changes, door closes, raw change, unknown effects; never infer causation from unselected counterfactuals
native_mechanism.memory: at most 4096 source-public context keys, per action actual own selected count and strict task effect count, each count <=4096; no cross mission alias; canonical checkpoint at no-pending-source boundary
native_mechanism.selection: off by default. Optional selected guard may propose only action 5 or 3 supported by at least 2 prior own selected samples and at least 1 observed qualifying strict effect in exact context; needs >=2 prior parent-selected samples for equal source rights, Bayesian-smoothed alternative effect rate >=0.5 and >= parent+0.1; parent gets original call and final selected action is committed through inherited native source ledger; do not override if evidence inadequate
native_mechanism.exposure: no source-world direct step or native release. Source-only synthetic fixtures can test fidelity but cannot establish learned policy improvement
native_mechanism.architecture: separate Wingless native Go and Yggdrasil local-cell Python implementations; preserve respective MG37/MG28 parent and exact source-feedback/checkpoint contract

required_source_free_tests: source selected action and returned original-public effect only
door open vs door close vs view-change vs turn
literal mission pickup vs mismatched object
abstain before support and when disabled
checkpoint cold restore byte equality / no pending checkpoint
invalid original-public shape and mission fail closed
Linux and Windows focused native tests
negative_controls: mission-blind / outcome label scrambled source-history with equal action information
strong trained conventional model-based/Bayesian/recurrent comparators required separately before original science
original_world_suppression: no actual original-world experiments and no claim of accepted learning/success from source-only tests; new cohort/first-use only by source owner under separate frozen scientific protocol and independent controls
resource_accounting: checkpoint bytes and per-event/choose CPU RSS latency must be measured before original-world promotion
fail_policy: Any unexpected source shape/selected step, tests or atlas qualification failure blocks promotion. Do not bypass ICE/G29 or FORGE autonomy.
